example.title: The Strand promenade below the bluff, Oceanside

brief: The beachfront promenade along The Strand: a broad concrete walk between a low sea wall and a lawn park of tall palms, lamp posts and benches, the bluff with hotels above and the pier running out at the end. Three photos. Resurfaced c. 1990. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
